# Step 3: Design for Large Screens

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Step 3: Design for Large Screens

![Step 3: Design for Large Screens](data:image/png;base64,)

For larger screens (width above 900px), we set the width of the container class to 80% of the screen and position it to the center.

Source Code

```html
1<body>
2    <nav class="navbar">
3        <div class="logo">MySite</div>
4        <ul class="nav-links">
5            <li><a href="#">Home</a></li>
6            <li><a href="#">About</a></li>
7            <li><a href="#">Services</a></li>
8            <li><a href="#">Contact</a></li>
9        </ul>
10        <div class="icon">☰</div>
11    </nav>
12
13    <div class="container">
14        <aside class="sidebar">
15            <ul>
16                <li><a href="#">Dashboard</a></li>
17                <li><a href="#">Profile</a></li>
18                <li><a href="#">Settings</a></li>
19            </ul>
20        </aside>
21
22        <main class="content">
23            <h1>Welcome to MySite</h1>
24            <p>This is the main content area. Add your content here.</p>
25        </main>
26    </div>
27</body>
```

```css
1* {
2    margin: 0;
3    padding: 0;
4    box-sizing: border-box;
5}
6
7body {
8    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
9    color: #333;
10}
11
12.navbar {
13    display: flex;
14    justify-content: space-between;
15    padding: 1rem;
16    background: black;
17}
18
19.logo {
20    font-size: 1.5rem;
21    font-weight: bold;
22    color: white;
23}
24
25.nav-links {
26    display: none;
27}
28
29.icon {
30    color: white;
31    font-size: 1.5rem;
32}
33
34.container {
35    padding: 1rem;
36}
37
38.sidebar {
39    display: none;
40}
41
42.content {
43    background: #f0f0f0;
44    color: #333;
45    padding: 2rem;
46    border-radius: 0.5rem;
47    border: 1px solid #bbb;
48    height: 40rem;
49}
50
51/* For medium screen sizes */
52@media (min-width: 601px) {
53
54    .navbar {
55        flex-direction: row;
56    }
57
58    .nav-links {
59        display: flex;
60        list-style: none;
61        gap: 2rem;
62    }
63
64    .nav-links a {
65        color: white;
66        text-decoration: none;
67        font-size: 1rem;
68    }
69
70    .icon {
71        display: none;
72    }
73
74    .container {
75        display: flex;
76        gap: 1rem;
77    }
78
79    .sidebar {
80        display: block;
81        background-color: #222;
82        color: white;
83        padding: 1rem;
84        border-radius: 8px;
85        width: 20%;
86    }
87
88    .sidebar ul {
89        list-style: none;
90    }
91
92    .sidebar a {
93        color: #ddd;
94        text-decoration: none;
95        font-size: 0.9rem;
96        padding: 0.5rem;
97        display: block;
98    }
99
100    .sidebar a:hover {
101        color: white;
102    }
103
104    .content {
105        width: 80%;
106    }
107}
108
109/* For large screen sizes */
110@media (min-width: 901px) {
111    .navbar {
112        justify-content: space-around;
113    }
114
115    .nav-links {
116        gap: 4rem;
117    }
118
119    .nav-links a {
120        font-size: 1.2rem;
121    }
122
123    .container {
124        /* 
125         Container is centered and 
126         takes 80% of the screen width 
127         */
128        width: 80%;
129        margin: 0 auto;
130    }
131}
```
